name: Devourer of Souls
summary: An Alliance warlock crosses the sea to seek Takar the Seer’s counsel on summoning a succubus. Gakin the Darkbinder sends Stormwind initiates into the Barrens for the wisdom they need.

sections.title: A Dangerous Journey West
sections.body: Beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind’s Mage Quarter, Gakin the Darkbinder guides promising warlocks toward summoning a succubus. The demon devours souls, destroys hearts, and dominates minds, so it cannot be called blindly into Azeroth. A warlock needs a potent lure: an object tied to pure love. That token draws the succubus from the Twisting Nether, where the warlock can defeat and bind it. Stormwind’s covens cannot teach them where to find such an object.

sections.title: The Seer in Hostile Territory
sections.body: Gakin sends his pupils across the Great Sea to Kalimdor in search of the needed catalyst. Takar the Seer waits in the arid Barrens, near the Horde settlement of Camp Taurajo. To reach him, an Alliance warlock must cross wilderness patrolled by hostile centaur, quilboar, and Horde warriors. The journey tests whether a summoner can survive before the ritual even begins.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: You travel from Stormwind to Kalimdor to learn how to summon and bind a succubus under your absolute command.

faq.q: Why do I have to go all the way to the Barrens?
faq.answer: Gakin the Darkbinder sends you to the Barrens because Takar the Seer has the occult knowledge you need to find a symbol of pure love, the lure required to summon a succubus.

aliases: who gives quest devourer of souls
faq.answer: Gakin the Darkbinder is a master summoner who works in the catacombs beneath The Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind. He teaches novice warlocks demonic pacts, bindings, and the dark arts away from the city guard’s eyes.
Takar the Seer is a mystic who lives in the central Barrens, just outside the tauren outpost of Camp Taurajo. He points traveling warlocks toward relics that can tempt demons into Azeroth.

faq.q: Why does a succubus require a symbol of love to summon?
faq.answer: A succubus is drawn to genuine, pure affection and devours it. As Gakin explains, the demon corrupts hearts and dominates minds, so a romantic relic can lure it from the Twisting Nether.

faq.q: Is the Barrens safe for an Alliance character?
aliases: will horde attack me in barrens
faq.answer: No. The Barrens is Horde territory, with hostile beasts, quilboar tribes, and settlements such as Camp Taurajo. Keep a low profile and avoid guards while seeking Takar.

angles.text: As a warlock, binding a succubus marks your passage toward mastering mental manipulation and seduction magic. Reaching exotic ritual reagents takes physical daring.
As an Alliance spellcaster, you travel deep into contested Horde lands, across the sea and the continent.
